scope: Research index for account-aware timing analysis of selected monster-drop bypasses. It reuses verified fact records and normalized actions; it does not add a drop rate, normal path, combat requirement, or throughput claim.
analysis_boundaries: A listed rate supplies probability context only; it never grants a drop, a number of kills, expected completion, or an account-specific completion forecast.
Combat snapshots and encounter observations are player-supplied context, not a proof of combat readiness, success, safety, supply sufficiency, or player competence.
Observed encounter duration and attempts are not converted into kills per hour, time to drop, or time to completion.
A rare drop is not selected by default. A caller must record an explicit objective before an otherwise accessible path becomes a bounded candidate.
Where the verified facts do not model a deterministic normal alternative, the comparison remains explicitly incomplete rather than inventing one.
